<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm, giving a total of 7 aromatic carbon signals. Therefore, the molecule contains 7 aromatic carbons.</thought>
